== Summary ==
Star Wars, nothing but Star Wars. The game's huge and awesome Wild Card event fills the room. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Matt Sokol]].

Identification: Bill Bisco, 25 October 2026, named Matt Sokol as the player in the beige cap and yellow shirt.
